approvedReleaseSelection: Use Overture STAC latest release dynamically unless owner pins an approved release.
powershell: duckdb -c "INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial; COPY (SELECT * FROM read_parquet('s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/' || $release || '/theme=places/type=place/*') WHERE bbox.xmin <= -93.5 AND bbox.xmax >= -106.7 AND bbox.ymin <= 36.6 AND bbox.ymax >= 25.5) TO '$source' (FORMAT PARQUET);"

npm run build:lp1601 -- --source "C:\GitHub\Gridly-Source-Data\Overture-Places\<release>\texas-places.geoparquet" --release "<release>" --retrieval-date "YYYY-MM-DD" --license "CDLA Permissive 2.0" --attribution "Overture Maps Foundation" --write
sourceNotes: Overture publishes cloud-native GeoParquet partitioned by theme/type and documents STAC latest-release access.
Do not download global Places unless explicitly approved.
